label: Art Movement
description: Historical art movements as style directives — era, technique, surface quality and palette behavior; characteristics, never artist names.

items.name: impressionism
items.text: impressionist rendering, 1870s plein-air manner, broken dabs of unmixed color, violet-grey shadows instead of black, edges dissolving in vibrating light

items.name: expressionism
items.text: expressionist rendering, early-1900s manner, jagged angular drawing, acid clashing color dragged on thick, emotion bending anatomy and perspective

items.name: art-nouveau
items.text: art-nouveau styling, 1900 poster manner, whiplash organic curves, flat decorative color held inside dark contour lines, floral borders framing the figure

items.name: art-deco
items.text: art-deco styling, 1920s machine-age glamour, stepped ziggurat geometry, gilded sunburst fans, lacquer-smooth surfaces in black, gold and jade

items.name: ukiyo-e
items.text: ukiyo-e woodblock styling, Edo-period manner, flat color planes with bokashi gradient skies, bold carved keyblock outlines, stylized waves and drifting blossom

items.name: surrealism
items.text: surrealist composition, 1930s dream-logic juxtapositions painted with tight academic finish, long shadows across empty plazas, scale quietly wrong

items.name: cubism
items.text: analytic cubist rendering, 1910s manner, the subject fractured into simultaneous faceted viewpoints, muted ochre-and-grey palette, shallow collaged space

items.name: bauhaus
items.text: bauhaus design language, 1920s workshop modernism, elemental circle-square-triangle geometry, primary red-yellow-blue on neutral grounds, form strictly following function

items.name: de-stijl
items.text: de-stijl abstraction, 1920s neoplasticism, asymmetric black grids locking flat planes of primary color into white space

items.name: romanticism
items.text: romanticist grandeur, early-1800s sublime, storm-lit skies in glazed atmospheric depth, tiny human figures dwarfed by mountains and wreck-strewn seas

items.name: baroque
items.text: baroque drama, 1600s tenebrism, sweeping diagonal composition, candlelit figures emerging from deep brown darkness, rich fabrics in saturated crimson and gold

items.name: minimalism
items.text: minimalist reduction, few elements placed at exact intervals of empty space, flat even light, disciplined near-monochrome palette

items.name: pop-art
items.text: pop-art treatment, 1960s commercial manner, flat CMYK color, enlarged benday halftone dots, hard black keyline outlines

items.name: brutalism
items.text: brutalist aesthetic, 1960s béton brut, raw board-marked concrete masses, deep shadow reveals, monumental repetition against a grey sky

items.name: abstract-expressionism
items.text: abstract-expressionist energy, 1950s action painting, gestural housepainter-brush sweeps, dripped and flung skeins of enamel at mural scale

items.name: fauvism
items.text: fauvist rendering, 1905 manner, non-local color at full saturation, vermilion shadows and viridian skin, drawing simplified to confident strokes

items.name: pointillism
items.text: pointillist rendering, 1880s divisionism, the scene built from small uniform dots of pure color mixing optically at distance, luminous still haze

items.name: rococo
items.text: rococo styling, 1740s boudoir elegance, pastel pinks and powder blues, gilt scrollwork frames, silk sheen and powdered curls in soft garden light

items.name: pre-raphaelite
items.text: pre-raphaelite manner, 1850s jewel-toned naturalism, botanically exact flowers, loose flowing auburn hair, luminous glazes over a white ground

items.name: constructivism
items.text: constructivist poster styling, 1920s agitprop, dynamic diagonal photomontage, red-black-cream palette, bold geometric wedges and stencil type

items.name: futurism
items.text: italian futurist rendering, 1910s dynamism, the subject multiplied into sequential motion phases, force-lines slicing space, machine speed in steel grey and hot vermilion
